title: 機械応用プログラミングⅡ
subtitle: Numerical Analysis for Mechanical Engineering II
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Acquire the ability of numerical analysis using programming (C or Python). (2) Acquire the ability of evaluating the results of numerical analysis. (3) Learn algorithms for high-accuracy calculation.
advice: This is a basic course in numerical analysis. We will cover the following topics: 1. Review the basics of programming 2. Review high-level programming (such as file I/O) 3. Numerical solution of an equation 4. Numerical solution of linear algebraic equations 5. Numerical integration 6. Numerical solution of differential equations Students are expected to write their own source code. Students should bring a USB memory stick to class to record their source code.
books: 数値計算法 森北出版
requiredKnowledge: Completion of “Numerical Analysis for Mechanical Engineering I.”

activityGoals.body: Be able to create source code, including I/O and simple mathematical calculations.
Be able to solve equations numerically.
Be able to solve linear algebraic equations numerically.
Be able to calculate volume and the center of gravity using numerical integration.
Be able to analyze an equation of simple oscillation numerically.
Be able to develop and use source code that addresses a problem in mechanical engineering.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Create source code with external functions (2) Solve an equation that has multiple solutions (3) Create source code to solve linear algebraic equations with high accuracy (4) Calculate the center of gravity numerically (5) Solve a motion equation of simple oscillation numerically (6) Analyze the motion of rigid bodies using numerical calculation
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Create source code for arithmetic operations, including logical formulas (2) Solve a quadratic equation numerically (3) Solve linear algebraic equations numerically (4) Calculate integration using the trapezoidal rule (5) Solve a first-order differential equation numerically (6) Analyze the motion of free-falling body using numerical calculation

lessons.assignments: Understand the course objectives Install the development environment for C or Python 3

lessons.content: Bisection method to solve an equation
Newton's method to solve an equation
Gauss-Jordan elimination to solve linear algebraic equations

lessons.assignments: Create a report on an issue as signed in class

lessons.content: Trapezoidal rule and Simpson's rule to calculate an integral
Multidimensional integral to calculate the volume and center of gravity
Euler's method to solve an ordinary differential equation
Runge-Kutta methods to solve an ordinary differential equation

lessons.assignments: Create a report on an issue as signed in class

lessons.content: Review of final exam Advanced numerical analysis
